name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Hang Clean
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart holding one kettlebell in front of your thighs with a firm grip and your elbow slightly soft.
Hinge back slightly at the hips, then snap your hips forward to hike the kettlebell upward close to your body while crushing the handle hard.
Catch the kettlebell at chest height with the bottom of the bell balanced upright toward the ceiling, elbow tucked beneath your wrist and forearm vertical.
Lower the bell smoothly back to the hang position, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Squeeze the handle tightly and keep your wrist completely straight to stop the inverted bell from tipping over.
Start with a light kettlebell and stay ready to guide it down safely if it tilts.
